subject: design/feature-draft
statement: The first three locked draft-born features form a fixed checkpoint cohort; record it once after their plan tasks close.
intent: Preserve a reproducible post-launch inventory for the operator verdict.
rationale: The checkpoint reads annotated v1 locks on pinned mainline, merged plan task issues, retained reopen events, and corpus paths; later locks cannot change the first cohort.
fit_criterion: A three-feature fixture writes one inventory with the feature list, corpus count, and reopens by cause; a repeated run writes nothing.
